title: Graph vertices and existing entities cannot be generic evidence-edge endpoints
wanted_capability: Reflective project-graph vertices (project_graph_vertex refs) and existing blackbox entities (project files, sessions, knowledge) able to serve as endpoints of generic, provenance-carrying evidence edges that cross source graphs and record graphs within an authorized scope: assertion authority, observation or mapping provenance, and freshness on each edge; traversal reporting missing, stale, and unauthorized endpoints explicitly. Needed so tenant records can bind to connector source facts and materialized bytes without collapsing authority planes. Tracked by design/connectors/reflective-graph-connector-program.md; donor implementation (.bbox/evidence/bindings.json overlay) exists on salvage branch campaign/reflective-graph-r2-projection.
missing_primitive: Tenant-owned evidence-binding overlay with canonical EntityRef endpoints and generic edge kinds
notes: Re-filed 2026-08-11 for the modernized connector campaign; replaces a pre-locality gap reference that was never present in any surviving store.
resolution_note: M3 cross-graph and cross-entity evidence bindings shipped on beta/blackbox-v2 (c0d3345f, branch feat/evidence-bindings, folded with M2 source projections; cluster verify green, full workspace suite green with one unrelated flaky bro-slack contention test passing solo). Tenant-owned bindings in .bbox/evidence/bindings.json ride a new knowledge-source lane with an append-only vintage ladder (PreGraphs, PreEvidence, Current) keeping every prior on-disk shape openable; canonical EntityRef endpoints with no connector-specific variants; per-binding assertion authority, provenance, and optional endpoint generations; whole-document replacement with invalid candidates leaving the accepted set intact; five-state endpoint freshness resolved at traversal and bundle time (only unauthorized refuses traversal); bindings surface through inspect (edge family on both endpoints), find_paths (traversable with per-step evidence metadata), and bundle_evidence (intra-bundle edges with provenance). Exit gate proven: a record vertex traverses through a source vertex to a project file with provenance preserved in reverse, including the cross-graph same-project case the wampum kit/instance split was waiting on. The M3 agent also caught and fixed a latent absent-lane digest defect that would have refused every pre-evidence record on open.
